method: Paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap: source-qualified benchmark strata, then matched task rows; equal stratum weights; native and alternative outcomes resampled jointly. Independent task resamples for repeated selected strata.
simultaneous_method: Bonferroni across all 31 model contrasts: each interval uses 0.05/31 total tail probability; approximate 95% simultaneous coverage under bootstrap assumptions.
label_rule: Label every positive contrast whose simultaneous lower bound exceeds zero.
scope: Conditional on observed model, study settings, harness alternatives and recorded repeated-trial means. These intervals do not establish an intrinsic model preference or family-wide effect.
